name: wp_config_ico_include
description: wp-config.php opening with an @include of a hidden .ico under wp-includes, the path written in octal escapes. Probes with a plain path and with the line in index.php miss as well, so the escaping is not the cause. The full scan answers its database and core-checksum lookups offline; neither reads includes in wp-config.php.
